title: Zesty Golden Polish Mushroom Pilaf
description: A cultured and flavorful Polish dish featuring a praline-french twist and a mirepoix base, perfect for a lazy Sunday, this flexitarian-friendly pilaf is a hearty and satisfying meal. It combines the earthy taste of mushrooms with the sweetness of praline and the comfort of a warm pilaf.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion, carrots, and celery and cook until the vegetables are tender, about 10 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the mushrooms and cook until they release their moisture and start to brown, about 5 minutes.
Stir in the praline paste and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the rice to the skillet and cook for 1-2 minutes, until the rice is coated in the oil and mixture.
Add the vegetable broth to the skillet and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low, cover, and simmer for 20 minutes, until the rice is tender and the liquid has been absorbed.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
